title: std1 UI check
description: A test for core-a4mk2 0.7's UI and system events on the Analog Four MKII: a std1 mod that subscribes to ev_boot_done, ev_idle, ev_crash, ev_usb, ev_key_leds, ev_mode, ev_param_set, ev_clip, ev_pattern, ev_mute and ev_view, and to core's own ev_knob_turn and ev_analog_frame, and records what each passes in ui_check (ui.c), with LED 0x20 read back through the LED slot table and palette; while armed (UI TEST in SETTINGS) it takes encoder B's and the LEVEL encoder's turns, every mute and every queued pattern change, and lights LED 0x20.
